context: A problem shown for a download, in the downloads of the requests service (from `createQbittorrentAdapter`).

text: הגרסה הזו אינה טורנט ש-Valence יכול לקרוא
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createQbittorrentAdapter`).

text: טורנט האוסף לא מכיל את הספר שאמור להיות בו.
context: Shown in the requests service when a book from Anna's Archive is sent to qBittorrent but its collection torrent has no file at the path the index gave.

Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createSabnzbdAdapter`). {name} is filled in by the app.

text: SABnzbd לא הצליח לסיים את זה
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createSabnzbdAdapter`).

text: הזן את התווים בתמונה כדי להתחבר
context: Shown in the captcha needed in the indexers in the requests service.
Why an indexer refused a search, when it gave neither a reason nor an error number. Shown with the indexer in the admin area.
Why an indexer refused a search, when it gave only an error number. Shown with the indexer in the admin area. {code} is the indexer's error number.

text: ההגדרה של האינדקסר הזה כבר לא נמצאת בקטלוג
context: Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `createIndexerClient`).
Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `createIndexerClient`). {status} is filled in by the app.
Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `createIndexerClient`). {status} is filled in by the app.
Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `createIndexerClient`). {timeoutSeconds} is filled in by the app.
Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `createIndexerClient`).
Why an indexer refused a search, followed by the indexer's own words, which are not translated. Shown with the indexer in the admin area. {said} is what it said.
Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `createIndexerService`).

text: במנוחה אחרי {failures} כשלונות ברצף: {problem}. הוא ינסה שוב לבד, עם הפסקה ארוכה יותר בכל כשל.
context: Why an indexer is skipped for now, shown on it in Requests › Indexers and in the requests health on the Overview. {failures} is a number of failed searches in a row; {problem} is the last failure's reason.
Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `createIndexerService`).

Why an indexer could not be set up: the site definition it names is not in the catalogue of definitions. Shown when adding or testing an indexer in the admin area. {definition} is the definition's name.
Why an indexer could not be set up: it was saved without saying which site definition to use. Shown when adding or testing an indexer in the admin area.

text: האינדקסר לא דיווח על יכולות החיפוש שלו
context: Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `readCapabilities`).

text: התשובה של האינדקסר לא הייתה Torznab או Newznab
context: Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `readIndexerXml`).

text: התשובה של האינדקסר לחיפוש לא הייתה רשימת תוצאות
context: Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `readReleases`).
A line in a request's history, shown in the request's details in the admin area: an album by an artist asked for has been released and is now wanted. {count} is how many.
A line in a request's history, shown in the request's details in the admin area: albums by an artist asked for have been released and are now wanted. {count} is how many.
A line in a request's history, shown in the request's details in the admin area: albums by an artist asked for have been released and are now wanted. {count} is how many.

text: בחר את {title}, אבל לא ניתן היה לשלוח אותו לקליינט ההורדות: {problem}
context: What was done with a search's releases, in the middle of a sentence: the best was picked but could not be sent to a download client. Fills {fetched} in a line of a request's history. {title} is the release's name; {problem} is why.

Why a finished download could not be moved into the library. Shown with the request in the admin area and to whoever asked for it. {reason} is the reason, which may be the system's own words and not translated.
A line in a request's history, shown in the request's details in the admin area: an episode has been released and is now wanted. {count} is how many.
A line in a request's history, shown in the request's details in the admin area: episodes have been released and are now wanted. {count} is how many.
A line in a request's history, shown in the request's details in the admin area: episodes have been released and are now wanted. {count} is how many.

What a search found, in the middle of a sentence, when one indexer answered. Fills {outcome} in Searched for {what}: {outcome}. {found} is how many releases were found; {count} is how many indexers; {fetched} is what was done with them.

What a search found, in the middle of a sentence, when several indexers answered. Fills {outcome} in Searched for {what}: {outcome}. {found} is how many releases were found; {count} is how many indexers; {fetched} is what was done with them.

What a search found, in the middle of a sentence, when several indexers answered. Fills {outcome} in Searched for {what}: {outcome}. {found} is how many releases were found; {count} is how many indexers; {fetched} is what was done with them.
A line in a request's history, shown in the request's details in the admin area: an indexer failed during a search. {indexer} is the indexer's name; {problem} is why.

text: קליינט ההורדות שלו לא דיווח איפה הוא שמר את ההורדה
context: Why a finished download could not be filed: the download client did not say where the files are, and which client it was is not known. Shown with the download and the request in the admin area.

text: אין בקבצים שלו אף פרק שעדיין מבוקש
context: Why a release is refused for a series request: once its files were seen, none of them is an episode the request still waits for. Shown in the media requests and on the downloads page in the requests service.

text: אין בקבצים שלו שום דבר שעדיין מבוקש
context: Why a release is refused for a film, music or book request: once its files were seen, they did not hold what the request still waits for. Shown in the media requests in the requests service.

text: כל מה שיש בה כבר בספרייה או בהורדה
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `judgeForRequest`).
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `judgeForRequest`). {reason} is filled in by the app.

text: היא כבר בהורדה עבור בקשה אחרת
context: Why a release was refused for a request: the same release, by name or torrent hash, is already in the download queue, sent for a different request. Shown beside the release in interactive search.

text: היא לא טובה יותר ממה שכבר נמצא בספרייה
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `judgeForRequest`).

text: שם הגרסה לא מציין שהיא עבור הכותר הזה
context: Why a release in interactive search can't be chosen automatically: its name doesn't say it's for the requested title (from `judgeForRequest`).
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `judgeForRequest`). {wanted} is filled in by the app; {held} is filled in by the app.

text: מתוך {held} העונות שיש בה, רק {wanted} מבוקשות
context: Why a pack of several seasons was refused for a request, shown beside the release in interactive search and in a request's activity. {wanted} and {held} are numbers of seasons.

text: איזה פרק זה? המספור שלו יכול להתייחס ליותר מפרק אחד
context: Why a release of an anime was held back: the way it numbers its episodes could mean different episodes of the show, so somebody has to say which. Shown in the list of releases found for a request.
What a search found, in the middle of a sentence: nothing, because no indexer is on. Fills {outcome} in Searched for {what}: {outcome}.

What was done with a search's releases, in the middle of a sentence: one was found, and it was not for this request. Fills {fetched} or {said} in a line of a request's history. {count} is how many were found.

What was done with a search’s releases, in the middle of a sentence: several were found, none for this request. Fills {fetched} or {said} in a line of a request’s history. {count} is how many were found.

text: אף אחת מ-{count} התוצאות לא התאימה
context: What was done with a search’s releases, in the middle of a sentence: several were found, none for this request. Fills {fetched} or {said} in a line of a request’s history. {count} is how many were found.

text: שירות הבקשות, שרץ בתור {runningAs}, אין לו הרשאה לכתוב ל-{folder}. הגדר את ה-PUID וה-PGID שלו לבעלים של תיקיות המדיה שלך.
context: Shown in the not allowed there in the media requests in the requests service. {runningAs} is filled in by the app; {folder} is filled in by the app.
A line in a request's history, shown in the request's details in the admin area: a finished download could not be moved into the library. {title} is the download's name; {problem} is why.
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `placeFile`).
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `placeFile`). {user} is filled in by the app; {group} is filled in by the app.

text: הגרסה הזו לא מכילה אלבום שהבקשה הזו מחכה לו
context: Why a release picked by hand for a music request was not sent: nothing in it is an album the request still wants. Shown when picking a release by hand for a request.

text: הגרסה הזו לא מכילה פרק שהבקשה הזו מחכה לו
context: Why a release picked by hand for a series request was not sent: nothing in it is an episode the request still wants. Shown when picking a release by hand for a request.
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`). {said} is filled in by the app.
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`). {title} is filled in by the app; {forIt} is filled in by the app.

text: יובא מ-{title}, חבילה של הסדרה שהורדה עבור ספר אחר שלה
context: Said in a book request's activity when a whole-series pack fetched for another book of the same series also held this book. {title} is the pack's name.

text: הגיעו רק {filed} מתוך {total} הרצועות. מחפש עותק מלא.
context: Shown on an album of a music request that was filed with fewer tracks than its longest edition has. {filed} and {total} are numbers of tracks.
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`). {size} is filled in by the app; {title} is filled in by the app; {folder} is filled in by the app.

text: {forIt} מהן התאימו, אבל אף אחת לא הייתה מקובלת — הטובה ביותר, {title}, נדחתה כי {why}
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`). {forIt} is filled in by the app; {title} is filled in by the app; {why} is filled in by the app.

text: הגרסאות של {group} לסדרה הזו ייקראו באותו אופן מעכשיו
context: Said in a request's activity when an admin answered which episodes an anime release holds and asked for the answer to be remembered for its release group. {group} is the release group's name.

text: הגרסה נעצרה עד שמישהו יגיד אילו פרקים הם
context: Said in a request's activity when an anime release's numbering could mean more than one set of episodes, so it waits for an admin to answer on the title's page. Counted by releases held.

text: שתי גרסאות נעצרו עד שמישהו יגיד אילו פרקים הם
context: Said in a request's activity when anime releases' numbering could mean more than one set of episodes, so they wait for an admin to answer on the title's page. {count} is how many releases are held.

text: נעצרו {count} גרסאות עד שמישהו יגיד אילו פרקים הן
context: Said in a request's activity when anime releases' numbering could mean more than one set of episodes, so they wait for an admin to answer on the title's page. {count} is how many releases are held.

text: זה לא הכיל שום דבר שהתבקש
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`).
Why an audiobook download was refused and blocklisted: it is much shorter than the book's full listening time. {have} and {want} are lengths, such as 3 h 50 min.

text: הבקשה נשלחת לאפליקציה מחוברת, שבוחרת בעצמה את הגרסאות שלה.
context: An error shown when an admin picks a release by hand for a request its library hands to Radarr, Sonarr or Lidarr (from `createRequestWorker`).

Why an audiobook download was refused: its files are numbered as parts, and one is missing. Shown in the request's activity and the list of releases it won't try again. {parts} is the missing part's number.

Why an audiobook download was refused: its files are numbered as parts, and some are missing. Shown in the request's activity and the list of releases it won't try again. {count} is how many; {parts} lists their numbers, such as 3, 7.

Why an audiobook download was refused: its files are numbered as parts, and some are missing. Shown in the request's activity and the list of releases it won't try again. {count} is how many; {parts} lists their numbers, such as 3, 7.

text: זה לא נמצא בקבצים של הגרסה שנבחרה לו
context: Why an episode is wanted again: the release chosen for it turned out, once its files were listed, not to hold that episode. Shown on the episode in a request.
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`).

text: ההורדה שלו הוסרה לפני שהסתיימה, ולכן הוא מבוקש שוב.
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`).

text: הקבצים של {title} מכילים עוד פרק אחד שעדיין מבוקש, ולכן מורידים גם אותו
context: Said in a request's activity when a release's files turn out to hold an episode the request still waits for beyond those it was chosen for. {title} is the release's name.

text: הקבצים של {title} מכילים עוד שני פרקים שעדיין מבוקשים, ולכן מורידים גם אותם
context: Said in a request's activity when a release's files turn out to hold episodes the request still waits for beyond those it was chosen for. {title} is the release's name and {count} how many episodes.

text: הקבצים של {title} מכילים עוד {count} פרקים שעדיין מבוקשים, ולכן מורידים גם אותם
context: Said in a request's activity when a release's files turn out to hold episodes the request still waits for beyond those it was chosen for. {title} is the release's name and {count} how many episodes.

text: ב-{title} אין פרק שנבחר עבורו, ולכן הפרק הזה מבוקש שוב
context: Said in a request's activity when a release's files turn out not to hold an episode its name suggested, so that episode is searched for again. {title} is the release's name.

text: ב-{title} אין שני פרקים שנבחרו עבורו, ולכן הם מבוקשים שוב
context: Said in a request's activity when a release's files turn out not to hold episodes its name suggested, so those episodes are searched for again. {title} is the release's name and {count} how many episodes.

text: ב-{title} אין {count} פרקים שנבחרו עבורו, ולכן הם מבוקשים שוב
context: Said in a request's activity when a release's files turn out not to hold episodes its name suggested, so those episodes are searched for again. {title} is the release's name and {count} how many episodes.

text: השם שלו לא מזהה מה הוא
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`).
Why a release is on a music request's blocklist: the album it held had fewer tracks than its longest edition.
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`).

text: {name} לא דיווח איפה שמר את ההורדה
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`). {name} is filled in by the app.
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`).

text: אף פרופיל איכות אחר לא מקבל את הגרסה הזו, ולכן אי אפשר לשמור אותה כגרסה שנייה.
context: Error when a release picked by hand for a film already in the library is to be kept beside it, and no quality profile other than the film's own would take it.

text: אף בקשה כבר לא צריכה את זה, ולכן זה לא ייובא אוטומטית
context: Shown on the downloads page beside a finished download a request sent but no longer waits for, such as one whose episodes came from other releases while it downloaded. Somebody can import it into a library or remove it.
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`).
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`).

text: זה {quality}, וזה לא מותר בפרופיל הזה
context: Why a finished download’s video was refused: its quality is not one the request’s quality profile takes. Shown with the request in the admin area. {quality} is a quality such as 1080p or a web download.
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`).

text: חלק מ-{name} מעולם לא נכתב לדיסק, אף שלפי {clientName} הוא מלא
context: Why a finished download wasn't filed into the library. {name} is the file's name; {clientName} is the name of the download client.
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`). {reason} is filled in by the app.
Why a release won't be fetched again for a request, shown in its blocklist ('Never again') on the admin title page, after an admin removed its download from Requests › Downloads.
Why a download was stopped and blocked: an admin picked another release in its place. {title} is the release picked (from `createRequestWorker`).
Why a download was stopped and blocked: an admin stopped it on the title page (from `createRequestWorker`).
A line in a request's activity log when an admin stopped a search that was under way.
A line in a request's activity when an admin stops a download and asks for another release. {title} is the stopped release (from `createRequestWorker`).

text: הופסק {title}. מה שהוא הביא כבר לא נעקב.
context: A line in a request's activity when an admin stops a download and stops getting what it was for. {title} is the stopped release (from `createRequestWorker`).

text: הופסק {title} וחסום, כדי לבחור גרסה ידנית.
context: A line in a request's activity when an admin stops a download to pick another release themselves. {title} is the stopped release (from `createRequestWorker`).
A line in a request's activity when picking a release by hand stops the download it replaces. {title} is the stopped release (from `createRequestWorker`).
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`).
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`).
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`).
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`).

text: לשירות הבקשות אין הרשאה לכתוב לתיקיית היעד ({message}). הגדר את ה-PUID וה-PGID שלו לבעלים של תיקיות המדיה שלך.
context: The problem in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`). {message} is filled in by the app.

text: החיפוש הופסק לפני שנלקח משהו. הוא יחופש שוב בהמשך כרגיל.
context: The problem shown on an episode, film or book whose search an admin stopped part way.

text: {title} נכשל: {reason}. הוא נכנס לרשימה החסומה, ו-Valence מחפש את הגרסה הטובה הבאה.
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`). {title} is filled in by the app; {reason} is filled in by the app.

text: חלק מ-{title} מעולם לא נכתב לדיסק, ולכן {clientName} בודק אותו שוב לפני שמייבאים אותו
context: A line in a request's history. {title} is the download's title; {clientName} is the name of the download client.

text: לא ניתן לייבא את {title}: {firstRefusal}. הוא נכנס לרשימה החסומה, ו-Valence מחפש את הגרסה הטובה הבאה.
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`). {title} is filled in by the app; {firstRefusal} is filled in by the app.
Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`). {title} is filled in by the app.

text: Valence לא יכול לגשת ל-{path}, שבו {clientName} שמר אותו. בדף ההורדות, הגדר את נתיב ההורדה של {clientName} גם כפי שהוא רואה אותו וגם כפי ש-Valence רואה אותו.
context: Why a finished download could not be filed: the requests service cannot see the folder the download client put it in. Shown with the download and the request in the admin area. {path} is the folder; {clientName} is the download client’s name.

A line in a request's history, shown in the request's details in the admin area: a search the requests service made. {what} is what it searched for, such as it or season 2; {outcome} is what it found.

A line in a request's history, shown in the request's details in the admin area: a search made under another of the title's names. {what} is what it searched for, such as it or season 2; {query} is the name searched with; {outcome} is what it found.
What a search was for: one album, by name, in quotation marks. Fills {what} in Searched for {what}. {album} is the album's name.
What a search was for, in the middle of a sentence: the whole film, album or book. Fills {what} in Searched for {what}.
What a search was for, in the middle of a sentence: one season of a series. Fills {what} in Searched for {what}. {season} is the season's number.

text: הקטלוג לא ציין כמה גדול הספר (סטטוס {status}), ולכן אי אפשר להוריד אותו בבטחה.
context: Shown in the requests service when a book from an OPDS catalogue can’t be measured before downloading. {status} is the HTTP status the catalogue answered with.

text: הקטלוג לא מציע חיפוש, ולכן לא ניתן למצוא בו ספרים.
context: Shown in the requests service when an OPDS catalogue’s feed names no search.

text: הקטלוג דורש כניסה, ש-Valence לא יכול לספק לו.
context: Shown in the requests service when an OPDS catalogue refuses to answer without signing in.
Shown in the requests service when an OPDS indexer’s address answers with something that isn’t an OPDS catalogue feed.
Why a download client a plugin provides couldn't be asked, when no answer came back (from `createPluginCallChannel`).

text: שרת Valence לא מחובר, ולכן אי אפשר להגיע לתוסף.
context: Why a download client a plugin provides couldn't be asked, when the requests service has no Valence server listening for plugin calls (from `createPluginCallChannel`).

text: מ-{group}, קבוצת השחרור של הסדרה הזו (+{points})
context: Why a release of an anime scored: it's from the release group the show is kept to. Shown in the list of releases found for a request. {group} is the release group's name; {points} is how many points it scored.
Why a release of an anime scored: it has an English dub, and the show takes subtitles until a dub comes. Shown in the list of releases found for a request. {points} is how many points it scored.

text: הוא מדובב, והסדרה הזו מבוקשת עם כתוביות
context: Why a release of an anime was refused: it has English dubbed speech, and the show is set to the original speech with subtitles. Shown in the list of releases found for a request.

text: זה לא שמע כפול, והסדרה הזו מבוקשת בשמע כפול
context: Why a release of an anime was refused: it doesn't carry both the original and the English speech, which the show is set to. Shown in the list of releases found for a request.

text: זה לא מדובב, והסדרה הזו מבוקשת מדובבת
context: Why a release of an anime was refused: it has no English dub, and the show is set to be dubbed. Shown in the list of releases found for a request.
Why an audiobook release ranks where it does. {format} is a file format such as M4B; {points} is the score it adds.
Why an ebook release ranks where it does. {format} is a file format such as EPUB; {points} is the score it adds.

text: זה מקוצר, ורק ספרי שמע מלאים מתקבלים
context: Why a release was refused for a book request: an abridged audiobook. Shown in interactive search and the request's history.

text: זה סרט או תוכנית, לא ספר
